description.en:
The importance level. Valid values:

- **0**: test
- **1**: normal
- **2**: important.

description.zh:
指定服务器UUID列表。多个UUID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可以调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances ](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The UUIDs of the servers. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
> You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
